documentation_excerpts.text: > [!IMPORTANT] > **This repository is deprecated.** For current Codex skill and plugin examples, use the [OpenAI Plugins repository](https://github.com/openai/plugins). If you want to add your own skills to Codex, follow the [Build plugins](https://developers.openai.com/codex/plugins/build) guide, which includes instructions for creating a skill-only plugin.
Agent Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that AI agents can discover and use to perform at specific tasks. Write once, use everywhere.
Codex uses skills to help package capabilities that teams and individuals can use to complete specific tasks in a repeatable way. This repository catalogs skills for use and distribution with Codex.
